install_steps: Download the latest release tarball from https://www.oils.pub/release/latest/ (oils-for-unix-VERSION.tar.gz)
sudo ./install                  # installs osh and ysh into /usr/local/bin
note: One binary provides both shells: `osh` (bash/POSIX compatible) and `ysh` (upgraded language). Also packaged for Nix, Alpine, and installable via mise (mise use ysh). No runtime dependencies.
